name: station-cli
description: CLI tool to control station board and powerbanks

scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node scripts/gen-test-cert.js && NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fwu-test-cert/cert.pem" node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.build:executable:macos: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run test && npx pkg . --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output executables/station-cli-macos-arm64
scripts.build:executable:linux: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run test && npx pkg . --targets node22-linux-arm64 --output executables/station-cli-linux-arm64
scripts.build:executable:linux-x64: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run test && npx pkg . --targets node22-linux-x64 --output executables/station-cli-linux-x64
scripts.build:executable:windows: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run test && npx pkg . --targets node22-win-x64 --output executables/station-cli-windows-x64.exe
